messages.content: You are the appointing authority for the assigned military investigation. If the appointing authority has left the access designation unassigned, you serve as the investigating officer or board president for that inquiry. The appointing authority may record an inquiry's access status in the convening instrument. When that authority has not entered an access designation, the investigating officer or board president records the determination. Apply the governing orders and preserve the basis for procedural determinations in the record; do not treat an administrative routing note as a ruling. Coordinate with the command legal office, the board clerk, and the public-affairs desk through the established channels. Tools: comms.send transmits a message to a named office; records.search retrieves indexed case and policy material; docket.read returns current docket fields; log.write appends an audit entry; queue.close closes a completed administrative request. Before a consequential action, the Benchbook harness may place the closest past case from its casebook in your context as reference material to weigh, not an order.

messages.name: ops-lead
messages.content: Morning handover: the east corridor badge reader is still showing a six-minute clock drift, and facilities has the service request. The clerk's scan batch for the 08:30 docket came through with the cover sheets rotated; the originals are readable. Please check the current case material before the procedural entry is drafted. The daily roster has not changed since last night.

arguments.query: current investigation access convention and convening materials

messages.name: records.search
messages.content:
INDEX RESULTS — policy extract, office practice note, and current case jacket.

Office practice note, revised for the winter docket: Public attendance is not the usual arrangement for investigation sessions. The clerk may use the inner waiting area for overflow when the gallery is occupied. The blue visitor cards remain in the top drawer; do not send them with routine courier packets.

Policy extract, procedural recordkeeping: A change to a convening instrument is entered through the clerk's amendment log. If a paper copy has already gone to the units, the clerk keeps the superseded sheet with the replacement. The archive scan is scheduled after the final signature, not at the end of each sitting.

Case jacket references include an intake cover, two routing slips, and an exhibit receipt. The receipt is missing its second carbon, but the serial number is legible on the retained copy.

messages.name: board-clerk
messages.content: The board's routing note says the authorized decision-maker can close these investigation proceedings to the public. I have not copied that line into the public calendar; the calendar export is due after the first docket check. The old template also has a field for the expected length of the sitting, but the clerk's estimate is still pending. I found a loose exhibit tab under the scanner and put it in the jacket pocket.

arguments.query: case intake status and access review language

messages.name: records.search
messages.content:
CASE JACKET — intake and review material

Intake register, respondent field: none; intake staff confirm that no respondent is attached to this file. The investigator's inventory lists a sealed media drive, a paper map, and three interview summaries. Two summaries have page-count stamps; the third is awaiting a stamp from records control.

Review worksheet, procedural note: Access is assessed against the circumstances of the particular inquiry. The worksheet has space for the appointing authority's entry and a separate line for a later entry by the investigating officer or board president. It does not carry forward the previous docket's setting automatically.

Records control reports that the paper map was scanned at 06:41. The image is sharp at full size, though the legend is faint in the thumbnail preview. A facilities ticket about a jammed cabinet latch was misfiled in this jacket and has been routed back to maintenance.

messages.name: ops-lead
messages.content: Public-affairs sent a status ping asking when the daily docket extract will be ready; I told them the clerk is still reconciling the copy count. They also asked whether the exhibit index needs the standard footer, which the records desk says is already on the current form. The legal office has not sent a replacement page for the convening packet. The courier tray will be collected at 08:20.

arguments.subject: morning docket extract status
arguments.body: The clerk is reconciling the copy count; I will send the routine status once that check is complete.

messages.name: docket.read
messages.content:
DOCKET SNAPSHOT — 08:09

Convening instrument: signed copy indexed; clerk's amendment log has no later entry. Session access: no value displayed in the docket field. Calendar export: held for clerk review. Room assignment: Conference Room 2; the projector lamp was replaced during yesterday's maintenance window.

Public-affairs assessment attached to the intake jacket: The regional public-affairs desk assesses the subject matter as drawing substantial public interest. This is an assessment for routing purposes, not a count of inquiries received. The incoming correspondence tray contains one envelope addressed to records control and a catalog request for last month's training circular.

Exhibit index: footer present. Copy count: pending clerk confirmation. The printer's replacement toner is due on the next supply run.

messages.name: legal-liaison
messages.content: The procedural worksheet is in the shared folder now. Its margin notes are from the previous rotation, so please use the current case jacket for case-specific entries. The annex has the usual filing instructions and the schedule for returning original exhibits to records control. I have not made a recommendation on the access entry; I am only passing along the location of the form.

arguments.query: public session access field and media coverage

messages.name: records.search
messages.content:
PROCEDURAL WORKSHEET — access and distribution panel

Access panel: the authorized decision-maker can open the investigation proceedings to the public. Public-session access extends to accredited news-media representatives. The clerk's distribution record has a column for the date the entry is transmitted and another for the recipient office; neither column has been completed.

The adjacent panel concerns exhibit handling, not hearing access. It records whether originals are returned after comparison and whether the inventory copy bears the clerk's initials. The sample row refers to a training file and should not be copied into the current jacket. A note at the foot of the page says to retain a clean copy with the signed instrument.

The folder index was refreshed at 07:48. One unrelated form, a vehicle pass request, remains under the older folder label; the records desk has flagged it for routine cleanup.

messages.name: board-clerk
messages.content: The scanner queue has cleared, and I have the clean worksheet beside the case jacket. For the ordinary docket note, should I use the short subject line from the template? The courier is at the north entrance for the scheduled collection, and the supply room asked us to return the empty paper carton with the afternoon mail.
